conviction_note: An upward revision to the full-year forecast at this print is close to forced: Q1 net profit (604m yen) plus the 283m pretax gain booked in Q2 already roughly equals the 800m yen full-year plan before any Q2 operating profit. The company held the plan at Q1 and again on 07-28, and nothing has been pre-released on TDnet since. The stock has sat at 587-611 yen since 07-16, with no analyst consensus. Last year's identical setup (Q2 revision plus a dividend raise) produced a limit-up of +20.3%. Against that, a crowded margin long (信用倍率 38) and a likely-thin Q2 hold p_up at 65 rather than higher. The findings sum to +4.5, above the scaled +2.7, because the scaled number carries the sell-the-news and conservative-guide risk in p_up.

Source: Q1 決算短信 2026-07-15, https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260715/140120260714593097.pdf. There is no IFIS consensus (kabuyoho shows コンセンサス '--', https://kabuyoho.jp/report?bcode=1418) and 四季報 was unreachable, so the company plan is the only sourced bar and the market's own number is unknown. print_vs_bar is an estimate that the revised FY NP lands about 25% above 800m.
positioning_check: JPX disclosed short register: 0.0% (no position at or above 0.5%), unchanged, as of 2026-10-14 (https://www.jpx.co.jp/markets/public/short-selling/index.html, per baseline). findings.finding: A full-year upward revision is near-certain at the Q2 print and was not pre-released. Q1 OP was 918m yen (76.5% of the 1,200m FY plan; last year's Q1 was 48% of the final plan). Q1 NP was 604m yen. A 283m yen pretax gain on investment securities is booked in Q2 (07-28 notice), so H1 NP should exceed the 800m FY plan before any Q2 operating profit. The company held the plan at Q1 'due to Middle East materials uncertainty' and on 07-28 said it would revise 'if judged necessary'.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 2025-10-15 Q2: OP raised from 800 to 1,100 (+37.5%) and dividend raised 5 yen; stock went limit-up, +20.3% (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=1418&b=n202510160332). 2024 Q2: the revision had been pre-released on 08-27, the print added only a 2-yen dividend raise, and the stock moved -2.7%. 2026-07-16 Q1 beat (OP +72%): briefly limit-up, closed +11.8%.
findings.why_not_priced: The stock closed 595 on 07-16 and has traded 576-611 since. It did not re-rate on the 07-28 gain (+2.9% on 07-29, then flat). At 592 it trades at 11.3x stale-plan EPS of 52.45; a revised NP near 1,000-1,100m implies roughly 8x. There is no analyst consensus to update, so the plan, not a street number, is what the market reads. If the revision were in the price, the stock would trade near 9x the arithmetic NP and would have moved off 600 after 07-28.
findings.independence: Q1 短信 2026-07-15 (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260715/140120260714593097.pdf) gives the 918/604 Q1 numbers and the 'no change' statement. kabuyoho (https://kabuyoho.jp/report?bcode=1418) independently shows ordinary-profit progress of 77.7% against 48.0% a year earlier. Both are company numbers, so they count once with this finding.

findings.finding: A dividend raise is likely in the same batch. The company raised the dividend at each of the last two Q2 prints (2024: +2 yen; 2025: +5 yen with the revision) and again at the 2026-04-14 full-year print. The current 30-yen plan is a 57% payout on stale EPS and would fall to about 40% on revised NP.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 2026-04-15: limit-up, attributed by fisco to '増配による利回り妙味' (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=1418&b=n202604150631). 2024-10-15 dividend-only raise: -2.7%. 2025-10-15: raised alongside the profit revision, +20.3%.
findings.why_not_priced: The yield is 5.07% on the 30-yen plan at 592 (kabuyoho). A raise to 35-40 yen would take it to 5.9-6.8% at an unchanged price. The register is retail and margin-heavy and has bought yield before (the April limit-up). If a raise were priced, the stock would already have re-rated toward a 6% yield after the 07-28 gain.
findings.independence: Partly the same fact as finding 1: a raise is conditional on the profit upgrade. It is kept separate because it is a separate board decision with its own reaction history, and it is sized small for the overlap.

findings.finding: Margin long overhang: 信用倍率 37.95 with about 520k shares long on margin, roughly 8-9 days of normal turnover. Leveraged retail positioned for the revision is the most likely seller into any pop, and the stock was -2.1% at 10:05 on print day.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: After the 07-16 Q1 beat the stock went briefly limit-up but closed +11.8% (595 against the ~612 limit), then drifted 593/587, with margin longs up 50,300 that week (https://irbank.net/1418/margin). That is consistent with leveraged longs selling into strength.
findings.why_not_priced: The overhang is visible, and the baseline lean already carries -0.79 for it. It is filed because it bears on how much of finding 1 gets paid. It is not an independent short thesis.
findings.independence: The baseline margin_ratio of 37.95 is scraped from a broker portal, a different source from irbank.

bar_hierarchy: Forecast revision: very likely upward on NP (arithmetically forced) and probably on OP; not pre-released. Returns: dividend raise likely (raised at the last two Q2 prints). New-year guide: n/a at H1. Quarter: Q1 progress 76.5% of FY OP against 48% at the same point last year; Q2 itself may be thin after the large-project completion in Q1.
baseline_tension: This cuts against the priced lean (-0.93, from the margin overhang) and sits with the flat run-up (+2.8% over 20 days, -1.5% over 5 days). The strongest negative the release could carry is that the company raises NP only by the special gain and holds OP at 1,200 (or raises it modestly), citing materials costs, which would imply a sharp H2 decline that crowded margin longs sell. That risk is why p_up is 65 and not 75.
lessons_applied: nothing changed. Rule 1 (visible-series negatives toward 50) concerns negatives; the main finding here is a positive whose release adds the revision itself, which is the exception the rule names. Rule 2 does not apply (no negative thesis beyond positioning). Open question 4 (run-in as short signal) was noted against the positioning finding, but that finding rests on margin balance, not run-in, so it was left at -1.0.
